summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of ThreadOS MVP inventory intelligence platform. All backend APIs (16/16) and frontend features tested successfully. Demo credentials work, all user stories validated.

backend_issues.notes: All 16 backend API tests passed with 100% success rate. No issues found.

frontend_issues.notes: All frontend features working correctly. Theme toggle, navigation, filters, charts, tables, drawers all functional.

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with demo credentials returns access_token + user
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me requires bearer token and returns user info
Backend: GET /api/dashboard/summary returns all KPIs, risk_counts, best_sellers (6), slow_movers (6), low_stock_alerts (8), recent_sales (30 days)
Backend: GET /api/products returns 40 items with categories, filters (category/risk/search) work, sort options work
Backend: GET /api/products/SKU-0001 returns sku, forecast, recommendation, risk, sales_history (90 entries), units_30d, revenue_30d
Backend: GET /api/products/SKU-0001/sales-history returns 90 day rows
Backend: GET /api/products/SKU-0001/forecast returns forecast dict with 30/60/90 day values
Backend: GET /api/recommendations returns actionable items (recommended_qty>0) sorted by qty desc, total_order_cost and total_order_units present
Backend: GET /api/risks returns 5-bucket summary with counts + definitions and items list
Backend: GET /api/forecasting returns items with sparkline (14 days) + confidence, sort options work
Frontend: Login page renders with demo credentials hint visible
Frontend: Login with demo@threados.com / demo1234 works and navigates to /dashboard
Frontend: Dashboard renders 4 KPI cards (Inventory Value, Total Units, Days of Stock, Low Stock Alerts), recent sales chart (30 days), best sellers list (6), slow movers list (6)
Frontend: Sidebar navigation works for all pages (Dashboard, Inventory, Forecasting, Recommendations, Risk centre)
Frontend: Inventory page renders table with 40 SKUs, search filter works, category filter works, risk filter works, sort works
Frontend: Product detail page accessible via SKU link, renders 4 metric boxes, sales history chart (90 days), forecast section (30/60/90 day), buy recommendation block, risk explanation
Frontend: Forecasting page renders table with sparklines (14 days) and confidence bars, search and sort work
Frontend: Recommendations page renders summary tiles + table, Export CSV button enabled and clickable
Frontend: Recommendations explanation drawer opens via info button, shows 'Why this quantity', 'Why this date', 'Risk if not ordered', confidence bar
Frontend: Risk centre renders 5 bucket cards with counts (High Stockout: 10, Medium Stockout: 2, Healthy: 7, Medium Overstock: 1, High Overstock: 20), bucket filtering works, clear filter works
Frontend: Theme toggle in topbar switches between light and dark mode, persists in localStorage under 'threados-theme', applies 'dark' class to <html> element
Frontend: Currency displays in GBP (£) throughout the app, tabular-nums class present
Frontend: Logout via 'Sign out' in user menu works, redirects to /login, clears token from localStorage
Frontend: Protected routes redirect to /login when not authenticated
